Entries.Original: Training complete. There were no notable mistakes.
It looks like today was issue-free.
But I was sooo bored the whole time, I started getting war flashbacks to when I was waiting during music festivals. Is it supposed to be this easy?
There weren't a lot of enemies this time.
Yeah, it was harder just tryin' to keep alert 'n' focused.
Even while we were retreating, there were only a few Cancer that we encountered.
This is all after the enemies have been wiped from the operation zone. There shouldn't be many enemies at all at this point, even in the real mission.
The encounter rates are also randomized in the simulation, so these things can happen.
However, if you ever let your guard down, you'll really regret it.
The most important thing is to keep working under the assumption that there could be enemies nearby at any time.
Yeah, I guess that's what we've been training for all this time.
That's true. We've been able to coordinate with the members of 31-A much more efficiently now.
You're all shaping up well. Tomorrow is the last training day for Phase Five, so stay attentive and keep up the good work.
That's all for today. Dismissed.
Thank you all for your hard work.
This is the end of training for today. Good work.
However, Cadet Aikawa ended up falling asleep while on standby, so this session has been deemed a failure.
Sorry 'bout that! I didn't mean to!
C'mon, what the heck were you thinking? This is serious training.
Additionally, Cadet Kayamori was also sleeping, so she is also at fault.
Darn, I've been found out!
*sigh*... Unfortunately, you leave me with no other option than to conclude that 31-A is unsuitable for this mission.
